title: Coronation Chicken
description: A classic British no-cook salad of shredded chicken bound in a curried mayonnaise and yogurt dressing with mango chutney.
ingredients: 350g (12oz) pre-cooked chicken breasts, skinned and finely chopped
1 red pepper, deseeded and finely chopped
steps: Simply mix all the ingredients together thoroughly, season with salt and pepper and serve.
notes: Great with baked potatoes, pitta bread, crispbreads, salad or pre-cooked bags of mixed grains. Use leftover turkey at Christmas instead of chicken. Substitute chicken for cooked prawns.
